# Raw Hair Suppliers (Tirumala Human Hair Impex LLP)

> Wholesale supplier of single-donor, virgin Remy human hair — temple-sourced in India,
> unprocessed and root-to-tip. Supplying salons, stylists, colourists and distributors
> across the USA, Canada, UK and Europe since 2011 (family sourcing since the late 1990s).

## What "raw" actually means (quality taxonomy)
- Virgin Remy: single donor, completely unprocessed, cuticles intact and naturally aligned
  root-to-tip. Inherently single-drawn. The highest quality human hair.
- Remy: cuticles aligned but may be multi-donor or lightly processed; can be double-drawn
  or super-double-drawn.
- Non-Remy / "machine Remy": collected shed (dead) hair, cuticles chemically stripped and
  mechanically realigned to imitate Remy. Often mislabelled "raw unprocessed hair."

## Sourcing
Hair is bought at auction from Indian temples where pilgrims offer their hair in devotion.
It is shaved (not cut or trimmed), giving a full strand root-to-tip; each bundle is single-donor.

## Products
Wefts/Bundles, Closures, Frontals, Keratin Tips (I-tip/U-tip), Wigs,
Clip-on Volumizer, Clip-on Sets, and Tape Extensions — all on single-donor virgin Remy.

## Markets & audience
Salon owners, hair-extension specialists, stylists, colourists, distributors/resellers,
new extension businesses, and private-label/OEM buyers in the US, Canada, UK and EU.
